script: NEAR's fee engine is Intents — about ninety-nine percent of DEX volume, roughly one-seventy times a cooling L1. Leakage is the bridge: close fifty million a year and fifty-X needs only about one-point-three X volume. Distribution takes sixty-seven cents of every fee dollar; the default rail turns eighteen percent of volume into forty-six percent of buyback dollars. Escrow now funds most buybacks — up from seventeen to fifty-eight percent in four months — so attestation is a clock. First dial: SwapKit tax. Then Ledger-first, rail share, attest. Hold until H1b. The dashboard is the proof — make the repo public.
